title: Runtime Governance for Agentic AI: Action-Boundary Control with Trusted Provenance and Fail-Closed Execution
abstract: arXiv:2608.16891v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Agentic AI systems request tool actions that can modify files, send messages, launch jobs, or change workflow state. This shifts the safety problem from harmful text generation to harmful operational side effects. Prompt-level governance can shape model behavior, but it does not create an execution boundary. We introduce Aegis, a runtime governance system that treats model outputs as action proposals and mediates them through a trusted decision layer before tool execution. The model proposes; the trusted runtime decides. Aegis evaluates proposals against active policy state, resolves provenance server-side, fails closed under uncertainty, and routes selected cases through Senate-style settlement, a quorum- based non-unilateral authorization path. We evaluate Aegis on a repeated sandbox corpus spanning five run families, 42 tasks, three conditions, and ten repeats per family. Across 6,300 rows, prompt-policy conditioning produced 79 risky

translated_title: 代理型AI的运行时治理：具有可信来源与故障封闭执行的动作边界控制
translated_abstract: 代理型AI系统请求工具操作，这些操作可以修改文件、发送消息、启动作业或改变工作流状态。这使安全问题从有害文本生成转向有害操作副作用。提示级别的治理可以塑造模型行为，但无法创建执行边界。我们引入Aegis，一个运行时治理系统，它将模型输出视为动作提案，并在工具执行前通过可信决策层进行中介处理。模型提议；可信运行时决策。Aegis根据活动策略状态评估提案，在服务端解析来源，在不确定性下故障封闭，并通过参议院式结算（一种基于法定人数的非单边授权路径）路由选定案例。我们在一个重复沙箱语料库上评估Aegis，该语料库涵盖五个运行家族、42项任务、三种条件和每个家族十次重复。在6,300行数据中，提示-策略条件化产生了79个风险操作。
tldr: 本文提出Aegis运行时治理系统，通过将模型输出视为动作提案并引入可信决策层和法定人数授权机制，在工具执行前实现动作边界控制，从而防止代理型AI产生有害操作副作用。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Aegis, a runtime governance system that treats model outputs as action proposals and mediates them through a trusted decision layer with quorum-based authorization, enabling action-boundary control to prevent harmful operational side effects in agentic AI.
